title: Evolving dark energy (DESI)
example_questions: What if dark energy is weakening?
Is the expansion of the universe changing?
summary: DESI's measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations, combined with the cosmic microwave background and supernovae, prefer dark energy whose strength changes over time (w0 above -1, wa below 0) over a constant cosmological constant. If real, dark energy may be weakening, changing the long term future of the universe.
support_note: A statistical preference, not yet a discovery; possible unknown systematics are being checked.
what_happens: Dark energy was stronger in the past and is weakening now
Expansion still accelerates today but could slow in the far future
